summary: This class explores the historical development and varying opinions regarding the practice of waiting between eating meat and dairy. The teacher examines the source of the six-hour requirement and discusses contemporary perspectives on whether waiting into the sixth hour is permissible, particularly in pressing situations.
questions: Is it required to wait a full six hours between meat and dairy?
What is the historical basis for the six-hour waiting period?
Can one wait less than six hours in a pressing situation?
Do different rabbinic authorities hold different views on this practice?
